title: Sketch a shaded sphere
safety_notice: Visual feedback cannot certify physical safety or hidden properties.
practice_restrictions: Author-written practice example. Consult an appropriate teacher for details beyond these introductory steps.
source_text:
Lightly sketch a circle on the paper.
Draw a small arrow above and to the left of the circle to mark the light direction.
Shade the lower-right part of the circle gradually, leaving the upper-left area lighter.
Draw a soft oval shadow to the lower right of the circle, outside its outline.

title: Practice a crochet chain
safety_notice: Visual feedback cannot certify physical safety or hidden properties.
practice_restrictions: Author-written practice example. Consult an appropriate teacher for details beyond these introductory steps.
source_text:
Make a loop in the yarn. Pull a small loop of the working yarn through it and place this slip knot on the hook.
Bring the working yarn over the hook from back to front.
Draw the hooked yarn through the existing loop to make a chain stitch.
Repeat yarn over and draw through until you have a short chain. Keep the loops loose enough for the hook to move.

title: Practice a steady guitar rhythm
safety_notice: Visual feedback cannot certify physical safety or hidden properties.
practice_restrictions: Author-written practice example. Consult an appropriate teacher for details beyond these introductory steps.
source_text:
Sit comfortably with the guitar supported and your strumming hand relaxed.
Set a metronome to a comfortable slow tempo. Count one, two, three, four along with the clicks.
Strum down once on each click while continuing to count one, two, three, four.
Stop and listen to a short recording of your practice. Notice where the strums drift from the beat and practice that part again.
